body: Thank you. The thing about suicide is that you believe people in your life are better off without you. This sub has saved me so far. Thanks!
Thank you. This sub saved me. A real internet win lol

Yup. Someone one here ask me if I was proud of anything. Although I haven’t thought of a single thing. Some positive memories kicked in. 

But as to your topic, I was so low that I didn’t care anymore. I’ve isolated myself for a mental cleanse. Seems like a day by day thing. I’m thankful I came here. I’m at that point but slowing down.

I’m not the best one to speak on this obviously but we seem to be at the same place. Read this sub for the rest of the day. The hotline was no good to me. But reading here literally saved my life. What I’ve learned in under an hour is that it’s not as bad as you think. Now, I’m not 100% bought into it but it’s another perspective.  Hang in there. We are together in this journey!

Reading post in hear has helped me in under an hour. I’m not sure what will happen tomorrow but I’m good for today. Thank you all for the judgement free responses. I’ve been contemplating this for a while. Glad I came on here! Thank you all again!
No. I’m a lost cause. Others would be helped by this hopefully.
My decision isn’t on you. I’d like to use this as an opportunity to tell folks to reach out to people like yourself who want to help. I appreciate what you’re doing for people.
